# swift-markdown-engine, vendored

- Source: https://github.com/Jon-Schneider/swift-markdown-engine
- Commit: `1c2e76c19888a767b8dde36ad347831c54db291a` (2026-07-10)
- Licence: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`)
- Taken: `Sources/MarkdownEngine` only (no dependencies). The `MarkdownEngineCodeBlocks` (HighlighterSwift) and `MarkdownEngineLatex` (SwiftMath) bridges, demo, tests and media are left out.
- Why: spike S6, the native-editor hedge against CodeMirror 6 (build plan; F-39). Not used by Duo itself.
